datasets.title: Somalia Motorised Travel Time (in seconds) to nearest health centre
datasets.description: A 100 m spatial resolution geotiff of motorised travel time in seconds to nearest health facility in Somalia. The data was generated using the Child Poverty and Access to Services (CPAS) software (10.5281/zenodo.4638563) and was created as part of the CPAS project within the Data for Children Collaborative. The travel time is calculated assuming driving speeds of local public transport options on all-weather roads/asphalt roads and walking speeds on all other roads, tracks, paths and land cover types. A full description is available here a video description of the data is also available here Projection system is: GCS_WGS_1984 EPSG 4326 for all. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/somalia-motorised-travel-time-in-seconds-to-nearest-health-centre]
datasets.details: The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) Common Operational Datasets (COD) Administration Level 0 boundary polygons were used in instances where geoBoundaries simplified polygons were not available. Where countries were not included in the health facility data published by Maina et al. (2019) we used data from the Global Health sites Mapping Project published on Humanitarian Data Exchange (this included: Egypt, Libya, Tunisia, Algeria, Morocco). For each country we removed health sites that were unlikely to offer child focused services and vaccinations. Facilities that were removed included: pharmacy, dentist, veterinary, café/pharmacy, social facility. The accuracy of the road data sets has not been validated, [Maina et al. (2019)](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-019-0142-2)

entity.name: Child Poverty and Access to Services (CPAS) software

lineage.description: Travel time surface generated using the CPAS least cost path method at 100 m resolution, which creates a friction/cost allocation surface representing effort to travel across different pixel types (roads, tracks, land cover), then calculates minimum travel time to nearest health facility assuming motorised transport on all-weather roads and walking on other surfaces.

sources.name: Child Poverty and Access to Services (CPAS) software
sources.description: Least cost path algorithm for calculating travel time across friction surfaces representing effort to traverse different road types and land cover. Incorporates driving speeds on all-weather roads and walking speeds on other terrain.
